name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Preroll | Super Cherry
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. Born from Super Buff x Tropicana Cherry, Super Cherry is a lively strain that pairs an energetic, uplifting high with gentle body relaxation. Its bright cherry-forward aroma with earthy undertones comes from terpenes like Limonene, Pinene, and Myrcene. Perfect for social settings or sparking creativity, this strain keeps the mood fun and easygoing.
